chunks: Then it will be said to them: 'Where are those you used to associate [with God]?'
ai.seo_question: What will be asked to polytheists on the Day of Judgment regarding their idols?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Ghafir, the polytheists are confronted with the ultimate futility of their idols, which will be unable to answer or intercede on their behalf. This moment underscores the Shia emphasis on Tawhid by illustrating that all created beings, including angels and prophets, are merely servants of Allah and cannot act independently. The rhetorical question serves as a divine rebuke to those who attributed partners to the One Creator, highlighting the transition from worldly delusion to hereafter reality.
